# CuNi

> CuNi is a programming language with one hard rule: one source either behaves exactly the same on every target it builds for, or it refuses to build. 53 catalog targets; `cuni check` proves byte-identical stdout. Open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later, or a commercial grant.

## One product, seven arms

CuNi is one product: a compiler trunk and one exactness gate, delivered
through Studio, Bank, Audit, Onchain, Exactness, Transparency, and Tap.
Every arm runs the same `cuni check`; none has an approximate mode.

- [ARMS](https://github.com/ceedot-rock/CuNIverse/blob/master/ARMS.md): the arm registry, human page
- [arms.json](https://github.com/ceedot-rock/CuNIverse/blob/master/arms.json): the same registry, machine-readable

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni): install, quick start, the exactness contract
- [CuNi Studio](https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/): hosted playground — run the exactness gate in the browser
- [SPEC](https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni/blob/master/SPEC.md): the language specification
- [GRAMMAR](https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni/blob/master/GRAMMAR.md): formal EBNF grammar
- [Agent-Rider](https://github.com/ceedot-rock/Agent-Rider): the agent coordination layer (CuNi exactness is optional protection there)
- [cuni-transparency](https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni-transparency): append-only Merkle log for signed exactness receipts
